verdict.summary: All error returns, NULL checks (share, malloc, mdl_ticket), and the sequence/view type validations are present and terminate execution on failure. Share release paths either return or re-acquire the share at retry_share, so no use-after-free or double release. No unguarded memory, numeric, or injection operations found.

evidence.reason: Sequence type confusion check present on all three paths (locked view, view share, opened table), preventing misuse of a non-sequence table.
